der_floh-effect_spread_mod.file-description: Spreads poison/fire/water ticks to nearby tiles when an affected tile is destroyed

der_floh-game_limits_mod.file-description: Tune performance-related caps (mortars, chunk loading, electric chain) via settings tab

der_floh-no_holes_mod.file-description: Fills air pockets in world generation so underground rock is always solid

der_floh-ore_value_mod.file-description: Configurable sell price multiplier per ore type

der_floh-passive_drop_mod.file-description: Configurable chance for ore (and other) tiles to drop a PassiveUpgrade on destruction

der_floh-performance_mod.file-description: Optimised chunk loading, tile effects, and level generation to reduce frame time spikes

der_floh-pickaxeaoe_mod.file-description: Electric pickaxe and AOE ability deal full damage instead of vanilla reduced ratios

der_floh-tick_upgrade_mod.file-description: Passives that speed up poison/fire ticking; effects keep ticking on unloaded tiles
